reuse.why: Threads the flag through the existing LinkAccountBaseParams/linkBankAccount funnel so every provider gets it, and extracts the unlink field-clearing from unlinkAccount into clearAccountLink used by both paths.

duplication.why: The unlink update is factored into one helper rather than copied; no logic is duplicated.

placement.why: Logic lives in accounts/app.ts next to the link flow, though the clearing side effect is placed inside a function named assertBankAccountNotLinked, which no longer only asserts.

scope.why: Only the flag, the guard, the extracted helper and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: Small, single-path design with a shared unlink helper; the mutating 'assert' function name is the only thing a maintainer would want renamed.
